NORTHGATE PROCUREMENT NOTICE

Suppliers wishing to be considered for the June equipment contract must upload pricing documents through the supplier portal by April 22. Product samples are not required at this stage. Shortlisted suppliers will be contacted by May 2 and may then be asked to provide samples. Questions about portal access should be sent to vendor.support@northgate.example.
prompt: What must suppliers do by April 22?
choices: Send product samples to the procurement office.
Upload pricing documents to the supplier portal.
